sentences.text: 2. One of the contentions raised by the learned counsel for the petitioner is that no evidence was tendered before the learned Trial Court to show that the bottle in which the curd was collected under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, was cleaned in presence of the accused as mandatorily required by Rule 14 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules.
Reliance is placed upon Raman Krishna Iyer Vs. State of Gujarat (2013(2) G.L.H. 144).
